title: Death of Bilgames: Ziusudra the last to be given immortality
summary: Matt tells of Death of Bilgames: Ziusudra the last to be given immortality, about ancient Mesopotamia at Mesopotamia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher called Matt, on Jesse Michels' podcast, points to an obscure ancient Mesopotamian clay tablet known as The Death of Bilgames, Bilgames being another name for Gilgamesh, the legendary hero-king. He says the tablet tells how gods called the Anunna gave immortality to Ziusudra, the Noah-like figure who survived the great flood, and that he was the last man ever to receive it. Matt raises it as a hint that ancient texts remember a lost age when such gifts were given.
